page1.text: I breathe, taking in just enough oxygen to move.

page2.text: I can only move my throat once.

page3.text:
I don't feel happiness or suffering.
My five senses have already turned to iron.

page4.text:
No matter how hard I tried,
my mind failed to stay intact.

page5.text:
Time to go.
One last job.

page6.text:
I unseal my left arm.
My consciousness is almost gone.

page7.text:
...One last Projection.
I'll make the strongest sword I know and destroy the entire Greater Grail, and this curse.
